Hi Samantha / Ethan,

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand FinServCo's priorities around customer onboarding, latency targets for real-time scoring, and the data residency constraints you mentioned. Quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Recap: primary goal is to reduce inference tail latency for scoring pipeline while keeping costs predictable across spikes. You have a small model team and a separate infra group that will own deployment.
- Next step: 30-minute product demo + Q&A focused on architecture and integration (we'll have a solutions engineer join for the deep-dive).

Proposed 30-min slots (all PT):
- Tue Jul 13, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Jul 14, 15:00–15:30 PT
- Thu Jul 15, 09:00–09:30 PT

Could you confirm which slot works and who from your side should attend (title/role is fine)? Also let me know any specific integrations or compliance questions we should be prepared to cover. I've attached a short discovery notes PDF from today's call.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.
